   33   # Returns where the centre bottom of a battler's sprite should be, given its
   34   # index and the number of battlers on its side, assuming the battler has
   35   # metrics of 0 (those are added later).
   36   def self.pbBattlerPosition(index, sideSize = 1)
   37     # Start at the centre of the base for the appropriate side
   38     if (index & 1) == 0
   39       ret = [PLAYER_BASE_X, PLAYER_BASE_Y]
   40     else
   41       ret = [FOE_BASE_X, FOE_BASE_Y]
   42     end
   43     # Shift depending on index (no shifting needed for sideSize of 1)
   44     case sideSize
   45     when 2
   46       ret[0] += [-48, 48, 32, -32][index]
   47       ret[1] += [  0,  0, 16, -16][index]
   48     when 3
   49       ret[0] += [-80, 80,  0,  0, 80, -80][index]
   50       ret[1] += [  0,  0,  8, -8, 16, -16][index]
   51     end
   52     return ret
   53   end

   55   # Returns where the centre bottom of a trainer's sprite should be, given its
   56   # side (0/1), index and the number of trainers on its side.
   57   def self.pbTrainerPosition(side, index = 0, sideSize = 1)
   58     # Start at the centre of the base for the appropriate side
   59     if side == 0
   60       ret = [PLAYER_BASE_X, PLAYER_BASE_Y - 16]
   61     else
   62       ret = [FOE_BASE_X, FOE_BASE_Y + 6]
   63     end
   64     # Shift depending on index (no shifting needed for sideSize of 1)
   65     case sideSize
   66     when 2
   67       ret[0] += [-48, 48, 32, -32][(2 * index) + side]
   68       ret[1] += [  0,  0,  0, -16][(2 * index) + side]
   69     when 3
   70       ret[0] += [-80, 80,  0,  0, 80, -80][(2 * index) + side]
   71       ret[1] += [  0,  0,  0, -8,  0, -16][(2 * index) + side]
   72     end
   73     return ret
   74   end
